name: Golf 2
description:
About This Game

"If golf is so good, why isn't there a golf 2?" -Someone, somewhere, probably

Well, now there is! And what better way to improve on the classic game of golf than by turning it into a roguelike deckbuilder? Play through a variety of increasingly challenging courses while filling your golf bag with powerful clubs and abilities!

Build Your Bag of Clubs

Over 100 cards means tons of different strategies and synergies to try out. Card types include clubs, abilities, balls, and caddies.

5 Course Types

Each course has unique, randomly generated layouts to ensure no two runs are the same.

Face Off against Your Rival

Multiple rival golfers with abilities and scores provide unique challenges for each course.

Visit the Pro Shop

Spend your hard-earned tees between courses to upgrade cards, modify your deck, and gain info on the next course.
short_desc: Golf 2 harnesses all the classic elements of golf into a unique deckbuilder roguelike. Play through randomized courses while collecting a golf bag full of powerful cards. Craft synergies within your deck to beat your rival's score.
